title: Quote with its clip
description: What the person really said, next to the clip where they say it. The clip fills 60 % of the frame, framed on the face; on the other side the words of that moment arrive phrase by phrase, thin and large, with one word in gold, a small quotation mark and a source line. Give the face box and the words keep to their own column: nothing is drawn on the person. Korean lines break between words. On a phone the clip is on top and the words under it.

props.src: required, the clip (mp4/webm) or a photo of the person saying it
props.lines: required, 2-4 short phrases of what was really said, one per line
props.gold: the word or words to show in gold (text as it stands in the lines)
props.source: small line under the quote: where and when it was said
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the body in 0..1 of the picture
props.side: right (default) or left: where the words go
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.alt: A stand-in for a person on camera
